description: Source code for Kubernetes RBAC v1alpha1 client, providing interfaces and methods to interact with RBAC resources such as roles and role bindings within the Kubernetes API.

classes.name: RbacV1alpha1Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with RBAC v1alpha1 resources in Kubernetes.

methods.name: ClusterRoles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster roles.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster role bindings.

methods.name: Roles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing roles within a namespace.

methods.name: RoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing role bindings within a namespace.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1alpha1 client using a given REST config.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1alpha1 client with a given REST config and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1alpha1 client or panics if there is an error.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1alpha1 client from an existing REST interface.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used to communicate with the API server.
